_about: Ground truth transcribed by reading each label photo (bench/images). Values are exactly as printed in the label's first numeric column; 'basis' says whether that column is per 100 g/ml or per serving. 'text' is a transcription of the nutrition table only (header + rows), used for CER/WER. Images come from Open Food Facts product pages (CC BY-SA). sample-label.png is a synthetic, clearly fictional label.
